item.title: War: US thought we’ll be like Venezuela, got stuck – Iran’s security chief, Larijani

item.title: Electricity Act: EERC issues 20-year power distribution licence
item.description: In line with the Electricity Act 2023 and the Enugu State Electricity Law 2023, Enugu State Electricity Regulatory Commission, EERC, on Friday, issued a 20-year distribution licence to MainPower Electricity Distribution Limited, MPEDL. With the licence, MainPower will be responsible for distributing electricity to customers across Enugu State. item.title: Six die, 12 injured as Benue Links bus, truck collide along Makurdi–Otukpo road
item.description: Six people have lost their lives in a tragic road accident along the Makurdi–Otukpo highway involving an 18-seater Benue Links bus and a truck reportedly owned by the China Harbour Engineering Company (CHEC). The crash occurred around 4 p.m. on Friday near the abandoned Benue Burnt Bricks factory. item.title: Borno attacks: VP Shettima vows no tolerance for terrorists in Nigeria
item.description: Vice President Kashim Shettima has reaffirmed the Federal Government’s commitment to ensuring that no part of Nigeria falls under the control of terrorists. item.title: Explosion rocks US Embassy in Oslo
item.description: An explosion struck the United States Embassy in Oslo, Norway, early Sunday, authorities confirmed, though no injuries were reported. Oslo police stated that the blast occurred around 1:00 a.m. local time, causing damage to the entrance of the embassy’s consular section.
